messages:
Rafael: Morning — Day 5 onboarding check-in. What I did: set up mac, installed homebrew & Docker, cloned the monorepo, ran unit tests (most green). Blockers: can't SSH into gpu-redwood-lab (ssh rafael@gpu-01 -> Permission denied (publickey)). I tried adding the key to the mac keychain but it still prompts. Also hitting 403 on private registry pulls — suspect .netrc not being picked up. Today: will open IT ticket, try verbose SSH, and push a tiny docs PR for the env var. Any quick pointers? :wave:

Sam: @Rafael try `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_rsa` then `ssh -T git@github.com` to verify key. On newer macOS use `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain` if available. When using a bastion also try agent forwarding: `ssh -A bastion && ssh gpu-01` — that usually fixes the Permission denied case. For .netrc, make sure it's `~/.netrc` and chmod 600. :thumbsup:

Rafael: Thanks — adding the key now. Here's the `ssh -v` snippet that shows the failure:
```
OpenSSH_8.1p1, LibreSSL 2.7.3
debug1: Offering public key: /Users/rafael/.ssh/id_rsa RSA SHA256:xxx
debug1: Authentications that can continue: publickey
debug1: No more authentication methods to try.
Permission denied (publickey).
```

IT-Ops: Created ticket INF-4823 for infra-proxy keychain access, assigned to Maria. Will update when we've added your key to the bastion. If you need immediate access we can temporarily add your personal key.

Maria: Hi Rafael — please DM me the output of `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub` and confirm your employee ID (e.g., RDL-122). I'll add it to the bastion's `authorized_keys`. For registry access, confirm the registry host and I'll check your service account mapping.

Rafael: DM sent with pubkey and my employee ID. Registry host is `registry.redwood.internal`. Also opened PR #12 to clarify onboarding env vars — note I changed `REDWOOD_ENV` default.

Jordan: I can review PR #12 this afternoon — ping me when CI finishes. FYI there's a flaky mac CI job we ignore for onboarding docs, so if it flakes I'll still approve after a quick look.

Rafael: Awesome — will ping when CI green. Really appreciate the quick help, thanks! :heart:
